channel.description: Gaming news, the real story and the argument about it. Terry says PC, Reggie says PS5.

item.title: Zelda Sells Five Million; Cats Get A Simulator
item.description:
Terry (PC, Steam Deck, master race, full price on day one) and Reggie (PS5, saving for a Pro, waiting for the sale) go through the last few days in gaming and argue about all of it. Everything in big type is made up, and so is the arguing. Everything in the boxes is real.

Zelda: Hero Sells 5.2 Million Copies Before Anyone Has Found The Last Heart Piece

Xbox: Fourteen Games Launch In One Day; Nation Can Now Be A Cat, A Banker Or A Cleaner

Shooter: Third Instalment Confirmed 'In Production'; Production Confirmed To Be Where Games Come From

PlayStation: God Of War Spin-Off Heads For The PS4; The Console Is Thrilled To Be Asked

Halo: Halo Remake Gets Firefight Mode; Terry Insists On Being The Fire

Awards: Golden Trophies Await; Nominees Told To Look Casual Until Tuesday

Big Game: Boxed Edition Contains A Code, Not A Disc; Nation Opens Box, Finds Slightly Fancier Receipt
